verdict.rationale: dltHub's own docs say pipelines are deployed with `dlthub deploy` and can be scheduled, refreshed, backfilled and observed through a decorator-based Python API. Its orchestration product page also describes scheduling and chaining pipeline runs with agents, and the AI Harness lets coding agents deploy and run pipelines on managed infrastructure. The evidence does not explicitly show recurring cadence (cron or interval) semantics as opposed to a one-off scheduled run, and there are no detailed scheduling docs or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/cron schedule documentation, details of the scheduling decorator API, hands-on or community corroboration of scheduled runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
